industries: Financial services lead the world's densest project market, with media, healthcare systems and big tech close behind.
intro:
New York's project economy is the deepest in the world: Wall Street's regulatory and trading-platform programmes, the media and advertising giants reinventing themselves digitally, healthcare systems consolidating, and a tech sector that now rivals the West Coast for headcount. Certified delivery professionals are the connective tissue — PMP for the banks' formally governed portfolios, Scrum credentials across the digital side. Competition for these roles is fierce, and the credential is what clears the first screen. There are live online batches all year for New York — pick a Saturday–Sunday weekend or a Wednesday–Thursday weekday cohort — each timed to fall within normal New York working-day hours; the schedule below gives the precise local start and end for every date. Corporate sponsorships and group bookings for New York teams are handled with standard invoicing.

New York's project market prices credentials in real time: banks, insurers and media groups run change portfolios staffed by a rotating bench of consultants and contractors, and certification is one of the few signals that survives a resume scan measured in seconds. In-house roles across financial services lean identically. The course runs live online over two consecutive days in Central-anchored hours convenient to Eastern time, shown on this page in New York local time — no midtown venue, no PTO. New York compensation for certified project professionals is its own economy; the sourced entries in the salary table below give dated local figures for offer season. The employer list reflects the finance-media-consulting demand base, and institutions can certify delivery pods through private cohorts.
